/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B - <<'PY'
import csv
import io
from solution import load_people
h = 'name,email,age,active\\n'
count = 0
def good(text, expected):
    global count
    assert load_people(text) == expected, repr(text)
    count += 1
def bad(text):
    global count
    try:
        load_people(text)
    except ValueError:
        count += 1
    else:
        raise AssertionError(repr(text))
for token in ['true', 'TRUE', '1', 'false', 'FALSE', '0', '']:
    good(h + f' Sam , SAM@example.invalid , 030 , {token} \\n',
         [dict(name='Sam', email='sam@example.invalid', age=30, active=token.lower() in ('true','1'))])
good('\\ufeff active , age , email , name\\r\\n0,,a@b,\"Last, First\\r\\nSecond\"\\r\\n',
     [dict(name='Last, First\\r\\nSecond', email='a@b', age=None, active=False)])
good(h + '\\n,,,\\n , \\nSam,a@b,130,1\\nJo,j@b,0,0\\n',
     [dict(name='Sam',email='a@b',age=130,active=True),dict(name='Jo',email='j@b',age=0,active=False)])
good(h + '\"Sam \"\"S\"\"\",a@b,' + '0'*5000 + ',false\\n',
     [dict(name='Sam \"S\"',email='a@b',age=0,active=False)])
for text in ['', '\\ufeff', '\\n'+h, 'name,email,age\\n', 'name,email,age,age\\n', h.rstrip()+',x\\n', '\\ufeff\\ufeff'+h]:
    bad(text)
for row in ['Sam,a@b', 'Sam,a@b,1,true,x', ',a@b,1,true', 'Sam,,1,true',
            'Sam,a@@b,1,true', 'Sam,@b,1,true', 'Sam,a@,1,true', 'Sam,a @b,1,true',
            'Sam,a@b,131,true', 'Sam,a@b,-1,true', 'Sam,a@b,+1,true',
            'Sam,a@b,1.0,true', 'Sam,a@b,١,true', 'Sam,a@b,²,true',
            'Sam,a@b,1,yes', 'Sa\"m,a@b,1,true', '\"Sam\"x,a@b,1,true',
            '\"Sam,a@b,1,true', 'Sam,a@b,'+'9'*5000+',true']:
    bad(h+row)
bad(h+'Valid,v@b,1,true\\nInvalid,bad,1,false')
# Round-trip varied valid names through the standard CSV writer.
for name in ['A,B', 'A\"B', 'A\\nB', 'A\\rB', 'A\\r\\nB', '\"', ',', 'A,\"\\nB']:
    stream = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.writer(stream)
    writer.writerow(['name','email','age','active'])
    writer.writerow([name,'a@b','','false'])
    good(stream.getvalue(), [dict(name=name,email='a@b',age=None,active=False)])
print(f'{count} targeted checks passed')
PY
 git diff --stat"
